rules.name: Task already done
rules.description: Suppress nudge if the related task is marked done or scheduled

rules.name: Duplicate nudge within 24h
rules.description: Do not send the same nudge type to the same owner within 24 hours

rules.name: Max 3 nudges per owner per day
rules.description: Never send more than 3 nudges to the same owner in a single day

rules.name: Suppress low-priority during overload
rules.description: When an owner is overloaded (5+ tasks), suppress low-severity nudges

rules.name: No nudges on weekends
rules.description: Suppress all nudges on Saturday and Sunday

rules.name: Approval already requested
rules.description: Suppress approval reminder if it was already sent today

rules.name: Only nudge on the due day
rules.description: Suppress reminder if the task is not due today or tomorrow

rules.name: Fallback available — no asset nudge needed
rules.description: If a fallback exists for a blocked post, suppress asset nudge and send fallback instead
